name: ci-helper
description: Helper script to run CI checks locally

scripts.ci:check: npm run ci:build && npm run ci:test && npm run ci:security
scripts.ci:security: echo '🔒 Security check...' && npm audit --audit-level high
scripts.ci:quick: npm run build && npm run test:smoke
scripts.ci:full: npm run ci:check && echo '✅ All CI checks passed!'
scripts.pre-commit: npm run ci:quick && echo '✅ Ready to commit!'
scripts.pre-push: npm run ci:full && echo '✅ Ready to push!'
